title: Video Studio pronunciation lexicon seed
description: The readings the platform lexicon starts with. Read once, when the platform has no lexicon yet; an administrator edits it in Settings from then on.

text.description: The term as written in a narration.

say.description: How the voice reads it. Letters read one by one are capitals joined by hyphens (X-T-M).

ipa.description: Its reading in the International Phonetic Alphabet, without slashes.

match.description: exact: the whole token, case and all; word: the whole word, case and all; case_insensitive: the whole word in any case.

apply_to.description: What reads the entry: the voice (default), the captions, or both. Captions keep the written form otherwise.

note.description: Who confirmed the reading and what it must never sound like. Documentation only.
